# Superseded

These files are the old shared Renovate preset. **Don't edit them.**

The live preset moved to the public
[`nf-core/.github`](https://github.com/nf-core/.github) repo as
`renovate-config.json`. This repo is private, so a preset here cannot be read by
the public repos that extend it — that outage is
[nf-core/tools#4446](https://github.com/nf-core/tools/issues/4446).

They remain only because other repos still point at
`github>nf-core/ops//.github/renovate/default.json5` and are being migrated. Once
none do, this directory should be deleted.

Background and the current consumer list: [`docs/agents/renovate.md`](../../docs/agents/renovate.md).
